title: Mid-Scale Concept Alignment & Magnitude Calibration (Legacy Prior Cohort)
intuition: Historical pre-refactor comparison cohort of `mid_scale_identity` retained under its original prior ownership contract so legacy baselines stay strictly separated from `recipe_owned_v1` tasks. Checks whether adversarial training preserves both the orientation (cosine >= 0.85) and calibrated magnitude (in [0.75, 1.25]) of opposing positive and negative concept vectors at intermediate scale.
failure_mode: Scale-uncalibrated step sizes or unbounded critic slopes either overshoot the target magnitude (>1.25) or shrink concept vectors below 0.75.
protocol_notes: Retained legacy diagnostic cohort for `mid_scale_identity` before the recipe-owned prior refactor; cannot substitute for current ordinary qualification cells.
